card.name: The word and after during
card.fires_on: The word "and" right after "during" in monitoring instructions, where "after" or "following" treatment comes next. It is weaker on "of" after "all" in web text.

modes.label: during and after
modes.description: "and" joining "during" with a later period such as after or following treatment.
modes.example: Monitor patients for the development of secondary malignancies during<< and>> after treatment with MATULANE.

modes.label: Stray web use
modes.description: The word "of" after "all" in promotional web text.
modes.example: Check out all<< of>> our galleries today.
